bundle: WI-12 / L-038 — preference-capital disclosure index across the three most recent audited annual reports
method: Case-insensitive substring search over the full `pdftotext -layout` text of each document, performed on a GitHub Actions runner against the PDF identified by the sha256 below. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages as produced by `pdftotext -f/-l`. Raw evidence: runs/01..04.
whyThisIndexExists: To make the negative determination checkable: the claim is not 'we did not find a sentence', it is 'in 793 pages of audited annual reporting the term preference occurs on exactly the pages listed below, and none of them states an issued preference amount, a nil, or an absence'.

marico-annual-report-fy2023-24.issuedSubscribedPagesProvenance: Read directly from the page extracts in source/ (the FY24 run indexed the preference and class phrases across the whole document but not the 'issued, subscribed' phrase).
marico-annual-report-fy2023-24.note: PDF p.189 = consolidated Note 12(a) Equity Share Capital (authorised includes preference 7 crore / Rs 65 crore; issued is equity only). PDF p.190 = Note 12(b) Reserves & surplus plus the closing sub-items of 12(a). PDF p.233 = the standalone statement's equivalent note. PDF p.254 = statement of changes in equity, historical preference rows (2002 issue, 2004 redemption).

marico-annual-report-fy2024-25.note: PDF p.185 = consolidated Note 12(a) (authorised 150/150, 8/80, preference 7/65, total 165/295 at both dates; issued equity only, 129/129 at 31-03-2024 and 130/129 at 31-03-2025). p.186 = continuation, including '(v) ... Issued, Subscribed and Paid-up Share Capital includes::'. pp.229-230 = standalone equivalent. p.252 = statement of changes in equity history rows.

marico-annual-report-fy2025-26.classPhrasePagesDisposition: Neither is a share-class statement: p.261 reads 'receivables are considered to be a single class of financial assets'; p.215 matches on unrelated wording ('value by Rs 9 crores').
marico-annual-report-fy2025-26.issuedSubscribedPagesProvenance: Whole-document index (runs/03); the standalone equivalent on p.250 was captured verbatim in runs/04 but is not part of that page index.
marico-annual-report-fy2025-26.note: LATEST audited consolidated annual report available at the time of this investigation. PDF p.205 = consolidated Note 12(a) (authorised preference 7/65 at 31-03-2025 and 31-03-2026; issued equity only, 1,29,54,97,599 = 130 at 31-03-2025 and 1,29,81,48,935 = 130 at 31-03-2026). pp.250-251 = standalone equivalent. p.275 = statement of changes in equity history rows.

marico-annual-audited-financial-statemen.note: Examined and rejected as non-qualifying: the document carries no share-capital note at all, so its silence about preference shares is silence about everything, not a declaration about preference capital.

negativeFindings: No document in this index contains a sentence stating issued preference share capital, in any amount.
No document in this index contains a sentence stating that preference share capital is nil or that no preference shares are outstanding.
No document in this index contains a class enumeration covering preference shares ('only one class of shares' or equivalent).
Authorised preference capital of 7 crore shares / Rs 65 crore is present and unchanged at every reporting date from 31 March 2023 to 31 March 2026.
